items.key: Could not prepare the map. Please try again.
items.draft: Imephu ayikwazanga ukulungiswa. Nceda uzame kwakhona.
items.backtranslation: The map could not be fixed (or: prepared). Please try again.
items.problem: 'Could not prepare the map' — 'ukulungiswa' reads first as 'be repaired/corrected', suggesting the map is broken. Use -lungiselelwa (prepared), matching 'Kulungiselelwa' used for 'Preparing…' elsewhere in xh.ts.
items.corrected: Imephu ayikwazanga ukulungiselelwa. Nceda uzame kwakhona.

items.problem: 'Preparing map…' rendered 'Kulungiswa imephu…' = 'the map is being fixed'. xh.ts already uses 'Kulungiselelwa' for preparing.

'Prepared example' rendered 'Umzekelo olungisiweyo', read as 'corrected example' (the release notes use -lungisiwe for 'corrected'). Use 'olungiselelweyo'; same fix applied to the reportUi*PreparedExample dictionary keys (dict-1099).
